name: The Coffin of Andy and Lili
source:
"The Coffin of Andy and Lili" takes the classic plot of the game but adds a new character named Cali Smith. Who is she? How will her relationship with Andrew and Ashley end? Is she going to die???

Who knows? But what's for sure is that it’s a coffin for three now.

[Edited from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BHXVaED743o]YouTube[/url]]
translation:
《安迪和莉莉的棺材》沿用了游戏的经典剧情，但增加了一个新角色，名叫卡利·史密斯。她是谁？她与安德鲁和阿什利的关系将如何结束？她会死吗？？？

谁知道？但可以肯定的是，现在这是一个可以容纳三个人的棺材。

[编辑自[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BHXVaED743o]YouTube[/url]]
